name: ibm-pc-xt
comment: Phase 28.0 — skeleton. IBM PC / PC-XT class machine: 8086 / 8088 CPU + 1 MB physical address space + 640 KB conventional + CGA text framebuffer @ B800:0000 + ROM BIOS area @ F000:0000-F000:FFFF. unmapped_behavior=zero matches typical XT bus (no last-value latch on the bus). Detailed handler wiring lands in subsequent sub-phases (28.1+); this stub only declares the address ranges.

memory_regions.name: ivt
memory_regions.comment: Interrupt Vector Table — 256 entries * 4 bytes each (segment:offset).

memory_regions.name: bios_data_area
memory_regions.comment: BIOS Data Area — equipment word @ 0x410, kbd buffer @ 0x41E, etc.

memory_regions.name: conventional
memory_regions.comment: DOS conventional memory — DOS kernel / TSRs / user programs live here.

memory_regions.name: vga_graphics
memory_regions.comment: EGA/VGA graphics framebuffer — Phase 28 out-of-scope; declared so writes don't fault.

memory_regions.name: cga_text
memory_regions.comment: CGA text-mode framebuffer (80x25 char/attr pairs, 4 KB used).

memory_regions.name: rom_extensions
memory_regions.comment: Option ROM area (VGA BIOS, etc.) — empty in our minimal config.

memory_regions.name: bios_rom
memory_regions.comment: ROM BIOS area. With --bios=PATH this is loaded from disk; with HLE mode this holds a tiny stub of IRET opcodes that the HLE BIOS attaches to.

comment_interrupt_vectors: 8086 RESET vector: CS=FFFF, IP=0000 -> physical 0xFFFF0. BIOS ROM placed at F000:0000-F000:FFFF, with a near jmp at FFFF:0000 to F000:E05B (XT-class cold-start entry).
